HERMES Agents — Forge Onboarding

1. Read the product spec
   - Open: HERMES.md in this repo.
   - This describes the interview → team design → profile provisioning flow.

2. Trust the Forge skill
   - In your HERMES agent, trust the skill at: skills/forge/SKILL.md
   - This skill is allowed to:
     - Interview you about your workflows.
     - Propose a team of specialized agent profiles.
     - Create isolated bot-mode profiles in profiles/.
     - Wire them into a sample workflow.

3. Run the onboarding wizard
   - From the repo root, run:
     python -m runtime.onboarding_wizard
   - This will:
     - Ask what you want to automate (domains, tools, constraints).
     - Propose a minimal team (roles, responsibilities, handoffs).
     - Ask for confirmation.
     - Provision N isolated bot-mode profiles under profiles/.
     - Create one sample workflow under onboarding/workflows/.

4. Inspect your team
   - Profiles: profiles/
   - Workflow: onboarding/workflows/
   - Skill boundary: skills/forge/SKILL.md

Notes
- Do not manually create files under profiles/; the wizard manages this.
- To re-run or adjust your team, run: python -m runtime.onboarding_wizard --refine
